news.title: Hibbett shares fall as Q1 sales miss analysts’ estimate
news.author: James Rogers

copy.hook: Hibbett still made sales. So why did the stock drop?
copy.explain: Hibbett, a sneaker and sportswear retailer, reported first-quarter sales below what analysts (professional Wall Street forecasters) predicted. The share price already assumed the forecast would be met, so falling short made the stock drop.
copy.takeaway: A stock reacts to results versus expectations, not to the results alone.
copy.question: Was Hibbett's miss about fewer shoppers, or shoppers spending less per visit?
